claims: Brahmagupta invented zero.
Zero separates positive and negative integers.
Zero is a real number.
Zero is an integer.
Zero is a whole number.
Some mathematicians debate its inclusion in natural numbers.
Zero is often classified as a non-negative integer.
Zero is an additive identity (a + 0 = a).
Multiplying any number by zero results in zero (n × 0 = 0).
Dividing by zero is undefined.
0/0 leads to mathematical contradictions.
The function f(x) = 0 for all x is called the zero function.
The zero function is the only function that is both even and odd, according to many sources online, such as this StackExchange discussion.
0! is defined as 1 to make formulas like permutations function correctly.
0^0 is often defined as 1 in contexts like power series.
In computing, 0 is used in binary code.
Zero is the starting point (origin) on a number line.
Indian mathematician Brahmagupta established the rules for zero 1,400 years ago.
Zero was once seen as dangerous or banned in parts of Europe.
The adoption of zero allowed for advanced algebra and modern mathematics.
